heading.zh: 历史 90 题成绩保留，但不是当前资格证明
heading.en: The historical 90-task scores remain, but they are not current qualification proof

body.zh: Chromium 90/90、Moli 54/90 是这批历史固定轨迹的原始验收结果，不做人工改分。但旧资格流程曾把返回内容为 [Snapshot error: …] 的 snapshot 动作按工具包装层 success 接受；37 道 RETRIEVE 题的 74 条结果均直接使用冻结的 recorded_response 验收，没有绑定本轮页面读数；历史运行还存在 Chromium 780×437/493、Moli 1920×1080 的视口差异。因此这些分数只能描述旧协议下的固定路径验收，不能证明 90 条轨迹符合当前 fail-closed 资格规则，也不能作为统一视口下的浏览器成功率。修正后的正式比较需要重新资格验证并完整重跑。
body.en: Chromium 90/90 and Moli 54/90 remain the original acceptance results for this historical fixed-trajectory cohort; no score is manually changed. However, the legacy qualification flow accepted snapshot actions as tool-wrapper successes even when their returned content began [Snapshot error: …]. All 74 results for the 37 RETRIEVE tasks used frozen recorded_response values for acceptance without binding answers to data read from the current page, and the historical runs used mismatched viewports: Chromium 780×437/493 and Moli 1920×1080. These scores therefore describe fixed-path acceptance under the legacy protocol. They do not prove that all 90 trajectories satisfy the current fail-closed qualification rules or measure browser success at a common viewport. A corrected formal comparison requires renewed qualification and a complete rerun.
